subject: KPI snapshot: Feb metrics + QBR readiness
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai, evelyn.hart@redwood.ai, tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: sara@acme.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: KPI snapshot: Feb metrics + QBR readiness

Team — attaching a compact KPI snapshot for February (see Feb_KPI_snapshot_v2.pdf). High-level items:

- Latency: p95 increased by ~12% week-over-week, driven largely by a traffic spike around 2026-02-12.
- Cost/unit: effective token cost is down 3% overall but embeddings pipeline costs rose in EU region.
- Uptime: 99.92% for hosted API; one 18m degradation window on 2026-02-12 flagged in ops.
- Usage: customer adoption across SMB tier +21% M/M; a few large customers (incl. Acme AI) have expansion signals.

We need two things before Monday's QBR prep sync:
1) Owners for brief runbook actions on the latency spike + TTL on cache invalidations (owner + estimated ETA).
2) A crisp slide (1 page) showing cause & mitigation plan for the outage window and the p95 drift.

Please review the attached and reply with owners and any clarifying numbers you want pulled into the QBR deck. Sara — fyi on the usage uptick from Acme.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
VP, Platform Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, marcus.lin@redwood.ai, evelyn.hart@redwood.ai, tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: KPI snapshot: Feb metrics + QBR readiness

Jonas — quick notes after a first pass:

- I pulled session-level telemetry and attached a small CSV with the latency buckets (latency_breakdown_0215.csv). Early signal: a subset of requests routing to a heavier model variant during the spike.
- For the 18m degraded window, Ops has the initial incident log but I want Marcus to confirm whether autoscaling delayed the warm-up.
- I'll draft the 1-page slide; target is EOD Sunday.

Owners:
- Latency root-cause & short-term patch: Marcus Lin
- Runbook update + TTL audit: Evelyn Hart
- QBR slide + narrative: Laura Bennett (I'll circulate a draft)

Attachment: latency_breakdown_0215.csv

Laura
Director, Product Analytics
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, evelyn.hart@redwood.ai, tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 11:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: KPI snapshot: Feb metrics + QBR readiness

Thanks — ack'd. Short follow-up from infra:

- Confirmed: between 08:13–08:31 PST on 2026-02-12 we saw elevated cold starts on a subset of Dedicated nodes due to a bookkeeping delay in the allocator. Warm-up latency for a small fraction of requests spiked p95.
- Immediate mitigation: increased pre-warm pool by 15% for the affected pool (deployed 2026-02-20 05:00 UTC). Monitoring alerts adjusted.
- Next steps: change allocator retry backoff (low risk) + add a brief telemetry tag to identify model-variant-induced routing. I estimate a rollout by Wed 2026-02-25.

Marcus
Sr. Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai, tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 21 Feb 2026 08:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: KPI snapshot: Feb metrics + QBR readiness

Adding TTL audit context — short thread:

- Found two services with a 0s TTL default on KV cache (internal misconfig during a recent deploy). This explains a portion of extra backend calls; should be a straightforward config fix.
- I'll open a small PR to set sensible defaults (30s) and schedule a sweeper job to detect 0s TTLs. Target PR + deploy by Monday morning.
- Also attaching the early QBR prep doc link: qbr_prep_template.gdoc (I put a proposed narrative under "Operational resilience" with the cause/mitigation bullets).

Evelyn
Head of Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai, evelyn.hart@redwood.ai, tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: sara@acme.ai, ops@cloudops.co
Date: Sat, 21 Feb 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: KPI snapshot: Feb metrics + QBR readiness

Great, team — appreciate the quick responses and owners. Recap / actions for the QBR deck and Monday sync:

- Marcus: implement allocator backoff change + telemetry tag (rollout goal 2026-02-25). Add short bullet on slide about pre-warm pool bump.
- Evelyn: PR to fix TTL defaults + sweeper job (PR ready by Mon AM). Add one-line item to slide "prevent recurrence: TTL defaults + sweeper".
- Laura: finalize 1-pager slide by Sunday EOD; I'll review first thing Monday.
- Tessa: please confirm whether finance wants a short cost impact note for embeddings cost drift (EU).
- Sara / CloudOps: thanks for the heads-up — we'll include a brief note for Acme on usage patterns (laura will pull customer-level numbers tonight).

Attachments: Feb_KPI_snapshot_v2.pdf; QBR draft link in related_links. If there are any blockers, flag them in this thread so we can escalate.

Jonas
VP, Platform Operations
Redwood Inference
